name: Morning scan
description: Scans TikTok and Instagram each morning for the top trending food videos and creators in the configured city and cuisine tags.
steps: Query the social connector for trending food videos matching cuisine_tags within city over lookback_hours.
Rank results by a composite score of view velocity, engagement rate, and recency.
For each result, extract: creator handle, video URL, view count, engagement rate, and the dish or trend shown.
Write a one-line 'why it works' explanation per result (hook style, sound, visual pattern, price angle, etc.).
acceptance_check: Produces a verifiable ranked list of exactly 5 creators/videos with populated fields within 30 minutes of routine start.
